Contract Compliance Thread - Meridian Foods / Oakcrest Distribution
Subject: Subcontractor labor complaint - action required

[Message 1, Meridian Foods Compliance (Ana Souza) to Oakcrest Distribution]
We received a complaint through our supplier ethics hotline. A worker at Riverside Cold Storage, which we understand is a subcontractor Oakcrest uses for the Meridian account, reported not being paid overtime for the last two pay periods. The worker asked to remain anonymous but authorized us to raise this with Oakcrest. Please investigate and report back within 10 business days per our supplier code of conduct.

[Message 2, Oakcrest Distribution (Ops Director, Priya Nair) to Ana Souza]
Thank you for flagging. Confirming Riverside Cold Storage is indeed a subcontractor we use for cold-chain storage on the Meridian account. We take this seriously and are opening an internal investigation with Riverside today.

[Message 3, Oakcrest Distribution, 8 days later]
Investigation complete. Riverside Cold Storage confirmed a payroll system error miscalculated overtime for 14 workers across two pay periods, not malicious, but still a violation of wage law and our subcontractor standards. Riverside has: (1) paid all back overtime owed with an additional 10% as a goodwill correction, (2) fixed the payroll system bug, and (3) agreed to a third-party payroll audit in 90 days that Oakcrest will oversee.

[Message 4, Ana Souza to Oakcrest Distribution]
Thank you for the thorough response and for meeting our 10-day window. Please share the 90-day audit results with us when available. No further action needed from Meridian's side at this time, we'll note this case as resolved in our vendor compliance file, with a flag to check in after the audit.

[Message 5, Oakcrest Distribution]
Will do, audit results will be shared by the agreed date. Appreciate Meridian's partnership in surfacing this quickly so we could fix it.

[Message 6, Ana Souza, internal note to Meridian Compliance file]
Logging for the record: this case originated from an anonymous hotline report, not a Meridian employee observation, and was resolved entirely through Oakcrest and its subcontractor Riverside without needing Meridian legal involvement. Recommend no vendor scorecard penalty for Oakcrest given the fast, transparent response; will revisit if the 90-day audit surfaces further issues.

[Message 7, Oakcrest Distribution, 90 days later]
Third-party payroll audit complete for Riverside Cold Storage: no further discrepancies found across the full workforce for the audit period. Report attached for your records.

[Message 8, Ana Souza, final file note]
Reviewed the 90-day audit report, clean results, no further discrepancies. Closing COMP-2214-equivalent vendor file entry as fully resolved with no outstanding items. No scorecard penalty applied to Oakcrest per the earlier recommendation.
